label: ROC-AUC
note: Second view of the same discrimination construct as PR-AUC.

label: Cost per run
note: Gamma log-link: ratio of ARITHMETIC mean cost. Model-factor effect is partly fixed by the price schedule.

label: Wall-clock time
note: Seconds/60. A pure rescaling: every ratio and every p-value is identical to the analysis in seconds.

label: Engineered features selected
note: Nested inside both of the two counts above.

label: Engineered share of selected features
note: ALGEBRAICALLY n_engineered_features_selected / n_features_after_fs -- not an independent endpoint.

label: Total tokens
note: Added because it is what separates a PRICE effect from a BEHAVIOR effect in the cost result. PLAN.md is explicit that token counts are NOT structural: resource use is an observed outcome.

label: Agent turns
note: Added as a price-free measure of how much work the workflow actually did.

label: Inner-CV score (Optuna best)
note: Added to test the optimism gap: does the score the modeling agent optimizes track held-out PR-AUC?
